title: Microsoft SharePoint Missing Check of Message Integrity Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to tamper with update data on affected installations of Microsoft SharePoint. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of SharePoint Help updates. The issue results from a missing integrity check on update downloads. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account.
